rationale: The most recent candle sequence tells a clear story: price rallied to touch the take-profit level at $92.60 (the session high) but was immediately rejected, with the last candle reversing sharply from $92.60 back down to $92.02 on elevated volume (86K shares), erasing the entire move. This failed breakout at the exact take-profit/session-high resistance, combined with current price sitting below entry at $92.01 and the momentum now pointing lower, suggests the long thesis has been tested and rejected. With the invalidation at $91.20 still providing some buffer, the mechanical evidence of a high-volume rejection at resistance favors exiting now rather than waiting for the stop to be hit.
